visual_review.method: Opened original game captures and inspected actual rendered content, including clear world view and visible resize handles.

findings_fixed: Opposite resize corner stays fixed at viewport edges
Native move preserves temporarily fitted saved size
Java menu shortcut cannot replace unfinished editor

test_fixture_corrections: Use a visible Enabled Mods panel for native overlap/default tests; inactive Status HUD has no geometry.
Use Minecraft26.3 InputConstants Enter/Escape instead of obsolete GLFW numeric test values.
scope_limits: Owned offline singleplayer game fixtures only; no personal worlds or inventory used.
No fresh public-server, second-player, arbitrary-modpack, alternate-renderer or extended endurance acceptance.
Java actual-game tests use supported development clients; public package content equivalence is verified separately after publication.
publication: Public release, Modrinth and final launcher installation checks are recorded separately after publication.
